safeguarding.quickExitHint: Leaves this page at once for a weather search. Shortcut: press Esc. It does not clear your browsing history.

helplines.intro: These numbers are free and work across India.
helplines.emergencyBody: Police, fire or ambulance, any time.
helplines.childlineBody: For any child who needs help, or any adult worried about a child. Day and night.
helplines.cyberBody: Report online abuse or cyber crime, or call the helpline.

form.title: An online report form is coming
form.body: We are building a form that works without an account and lets you stay anonymous. Until it opens, please use the email or phone above.
